subject: Request: additional trial quota for throughput POC (EdgeAI Labs)
messages:
From: Katie Lin <katie@edgeailabs.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 31 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Trial quota bump request for POC throughput run

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the throughput and latency numbers looked promising. We're ramping up a week-long load validation run next Tues–Thu (Nov 3–5) and need a temporary increase to our trial quota so we can simulate sustained concurrent requests across multiple pipelines.

Current ask: +300k token capacity and a short-lived bump to 16 concurrent request slots for 72 hours (UTC window: Nov 3 00:00 — Nov 5 23:59).

Attached is our test plan (hc_poc_load_plan.xlsx) with expected request patterns and target perf metrics. Happy to jump on a quick call to walk through it.

Can you advise on approval steps and whether Redwood can provide a short promo code or account-level top-up for this run?

Cheers,
Katie Lin
Head of Ops, EdgeAI Labs
katie@edgeailabs.com
[Attachment: hc_poc_load_plan.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

Hi Katie — thanks for the plan, looks thorough.

Two quick questions before I route this to ops for a temporary top-up:
- Do you need the additional token capacity to be available for the entire 72-hour window, or can we stage it (peak hours only)?
- Are there any compliance constraints (PII, retention) we should flag to the Private deployment team?

I'll loop in Ben from Sales Ops to help with the approval and the promo code cadence. If you can confirm the staging preference, we'll try to turn this around fast.

Thanks for the context, Katie — appreciate the detailed plan.

Operationally, we can support temporary trial boosts for Strategic POCs with a short approval from Sales Ops (Neha). Typical approach:
- Provide a time-boxed quota bump (token units + concurrency) tied to a runbook and success criteria.
- Require acceptance of the trial terms (attached) and a signed confirmation email agreeing to the window.
- If the run impacts capacity materially, we'll schedule it in our staging pool during the specified window.

Hannah — given their timelines, can you confirm staging vs full-window? If they need full-window we'll flag for an expedited promo issuance.

Katie — if you can also share whether you'll run in us-east region (preferred) or elsewhere, that helps us reserve capacity.

-Ben

Subject: Approval: temporary quota increase for EdgeAI Labs (DEAL-4821)

Hi all — after reviewing the test plan and expected impact, Sales Ops approves the temporary quota increase. Summary of approved changes:
- Token units: +300,000 tokens (one-time allocation)
- Concurrency: 16 concurrent request slots for a 72-hour window
- Window: 2026-11-03T00:00:00Z through 2026-11-05T23:59:00Z (UTC)
- Region: us-east (preferred)
- Success criteria: maintain median tail latency < 220ms and no more than 1.5% error rate for the run period (per provided runbook)

Provisioning steps taken:
- Temporary promo code: REDWOOD-POC-4821-72H (expires 2026-11-06T00:00:00Z) — apply to account-level billing to unlock the additional quota.
- Attached are the trial terms and the runbook excerpt for logging expectations. Please acknowledge receipt and paste the promo code confirmation back in this thread.

Attachments: redwood_trial_terms.pdf (summary of trial terms; required), hc_poc_load_plan.xlsx (submitted by EdgeAI)

Thanks — Neha
